messages.subject: Quick Plotting of Data
parts:
Hi Karl et al.,

I'm wondering if there would be a quick way to pull genotypes for all individuals in a specific region (say a string of 5-10 markers) and place them in a new vector sorted by their increasing phenotypic response?

Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Quick Plotting of Data
parts:
You can use pull.geno() to pull out the genotypes as a matrix, individuals as rows and markers as columns.
It takes a 'chr' argument if you want just one or some set of selected chromosomes.

karl
